result.question: What must commanders do before seeing king's son?

readings.answer: Enter into a covenant and be put under oath
readings.support: made a covenant with them and put them under oath

readings.answer: Be brought into the house of the LORD
readings.support: had them brought into the house of the LORD

assessments.reason: The text says, “There he made a covenant with them and put them under oath. He showed them the king’s son,” so covenant and oath precede seeing the king’s son.
The passage states he “had them brought into the house of the LORD… He showed them the king’s son,” so being brought into the house also occurred before seeing the king’s son.

result.reason: The passage describes more than one action occurring before he showed them the king’s son (being brought into the house, then covenant and oath), so multiple distinct answers fit.
